Name: SDV-Radiance
Author: PHUICMT
Description:
[center][size=5]SDV-Radiance[/size]
[b]A full lighting and post-processing suite for Stardew Valley, in one mod.[/b]

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/49397/49397-1784551432-500055663.png[/img][/center]
[color=#D4D4D8]
Most cinematic setups stack half a dozen mods to get shadows, reflections, god rays, and richer light. [b]SDV-Radiance does it in one: a single GPU post-processing layer that reads what's actually on your screen, so it works with your sprites, recolors, and map mods automatically.[/b] Every effect has its own switch and sliders, previewed live through an in-game tuner.[/color]


[center][color=#D4D4D8][size=4]🚧 Active development[/size]
This mod is [b]actively being developed[/b]. It's stable and safe to use (no save data is touched, and you can toggle or uninstall anything at any time), but you may run into rough edges in some scenes, mod combos, or hardware. New features and fixes land regularly.

If something looks off, a quick report on the [b]Bugs[/b] tab [b](screenshot + SMAPI log)[/b] genuinely helps shape where it goes next. Thanks for trying it early. 💛[/color][/center]
[color=#D4D4D8]
[size=5]⚠️ Known issues[/size][/color]
[list]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Water detection on shorelines and heavily-custom maps[/b] is close but not exact. Radiance works out where water is from tile data and colour, and a beach or a modded map can still get effects slightly outside the water. 1.2.2 fixes the visible version of this (sand no longer takes the effect), and the real cure is underway: I am hand-labelling water, lava and waterfalls pixel by pixel across the popular map mods so the mod reads a real map instead of guessing. Liquids come first. In the meantime the indoor and per-room water switches let you turn the water effect off exactly where you want.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]SpriteMaster-based mods[/b] (Clear Glasses, Clear Monocle): incompatible, and there is no reliable workaround. Pick one or the other for now.[/color][/*]
[/list][color=#D4D4D8]
[size=5]🔭 In development[/size][/color]
[list]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Pixel-accurate water detection built on hand-labelled ground truth, so effects only ever touch real open water. This pass is in progress right now, liquids first, across the map mods people actually play.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Water sub-types driven by that labeling: ice that reflects without rippling, flowing water and waterfalls, and glowing lava, plus warm window light at night.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Reflective surfaces beyond water: wet floors and glass or mirrors (bus windows, shop fronts).[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Building shadows that respect map mods like SVE and RSV, with user-editable data files.[/color][/*]
[/list][color=#D4D4D8]

[size=5]✨ What it does[/size]

[b]Lighting & Shadows[/b][/color]
[list]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Directional shadows[/b] for characters, animals, trees, objects, crops, and map props: the real sprite silhouette, leaning and stretching with the sun through the day, fading at dusk.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Moonlight shadows[/b] at night, scaled by the lunar phase and season.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Per-light indoor shadows[/b]: every lamp, torch, and fireplace casts its own soft shadow.[/color][/*]
[*][b][color=#d4d4d8]Occlusion-aware GI lighting[/color][/b][color=#d4d4d8]: flat, over-bright interiors get depth; warm light pools around real light sources and is blocked by walls.[/color][/*]
[/list][color=#D4D4D8]
[b]Water[/b][/color]
[list]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Pixel-accurate reflections[/b]: the scene above the water is mirrored along the [i]real painted shoreline[/i], not a square tile edge. Banks, trees, bridges, and piers all reflect correctly.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Wading self-reflection[/b]: step into a shallow pool and your own reflection follows you.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Ripple, sparkle, and surface shimmer[/b]: pond and ocean behave differently, adapting to weather and season. Small ponds ripple gently while open ocean stays lively, judged from the size of each body of water.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Accurate detection[/b]: water is picked up from what the game actually draws, so custom-map water and water added by other mods line up correctly. Real level water (caves, mines, the sewer, the hot spring) is always kept, while decorative water inside house or interior mods can be switched off globally or per room.[/color][/*]
[/list][color=#D4D4D8]
[b]Atmosphere & Color[/b][/color]
[list]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]God rays[/b] from real in-world light sources.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Cloud shadows[/b] drifting softly across the ground, with controls for how many banks share the sky, their coverage, size and speed.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Day fog and night mist[/b]: two separate effects rendered as soft drifting wisps, each with its own amount, intensity and drift speed.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Bloom[/b], [b]tilt-shift[/b] depth blur, [b]vignette[/b], and subtle [b]chromatic aberration[/b].[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Cinematic color grading[/b]: mood and palette shift automatically by time of day, weather, and season, with metered auto-exposure.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Blue light filter[/b]: an optional warm eye comfort shift, layered on top of the grade or used on its own.[/color][/*]
[/list][center] [img width=275]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/49397/49397-1784552062-1397391653.png[/img] [img width=275]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/49397/49397-1784552034-1606604367.png[/img]

[center] [/center]
[center][img width=275]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/49397/49397-1784551573-1137622386.png[/img] [img width=275]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/49397/49397-1784551582-774586989.png[/img][/center]
[center][color=#D4D4D8][i]Vanilla (left) vs. SDV-Radiance (right)[/i][/color][/center]
[color=#D4D4D8]
[size=5]🎛️ Fully configurable[/size]
Press [b]F6[/b] in-game for the live tuner, now organized into tabs by category (color, bloom, shadows, lighting, god rays, cloud, fog, water, lens): drag any slider and watch the world update instantly, save your own named looks, or pick a preset (Subtle / Cinematic / Vibrant). Everything is also in [b]Generic Mod Config Menu[/b]. Every single effect can be turned off individually, so you can dial it to your machine and taste.[/color]


[center][color=#D4D4D8][img width=365]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/49397/49397-1784552176-1384135743.png[/img][/color][/center]
[color=#D4D4D8]
[size=5]📦 Installation[/size][/color]
[list=1]
[*][color=#d4d4d8]Install [/color][url=https://smapi.io]SMAPI[/url][color=#d4d4d8] (4.0.0 or newer).[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] (optional, recommended for the settings menu).[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Download this mod and unzip it into your [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font] folder.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Run the game through SMAPI. Press [b]F6[/b] for the tuner, [b]F7[/b] to toggle the whole stack.[/color][/*]
[/list][color=#D4D4D8]
[size=5]⚙️ Performance[/size]
It's a multi-pass GPU pipeline: one capture, one shader chain, with baked results cached between frames. It runs on the rendered image, so your number of other mods barely affects it. 1.2.0 added a big optimization pass: the water and shadow systems no longer scan the whole map every frame, tile art is read back once per sheet instead of once per tile, and the old stutter when walking near water is gone. Every effect still has an on/off switch, so if a scene is heavy you can drop the ones you don't need (flood lighting, directional shadows, and god rays are the heaviest).

[size=5]🧩 Compatibility[/size][/color]
[list]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Works automatically with appearance mods[/b]: shadows and reflections are generated from what's actually rendered, so custom sprites, Fashion Sense outfits, and recolors just work.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Tested alongside large setups including SVE and 80+ mods.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Global God Rays[/b]: confirmed working together by several users. Radiance hugs in-world lights while GGR does the sun shafts, so they stack nicely. As of 1.2.1, when Radiance hides the vanilla drifting clouds it clears them fully, so GGR no longer fades its rays under a shadow you can't see.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Single-player.[/b] Multiplayer: the effects are client-side (each player sees their own).[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Android: not supported.[/b][/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Other post-processing / lighting mods (e.g. Dynamic Shader, ReShade) may overlap. Run one at a time for a predictable look.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Not compatible with SpriteMaster[/b] (also distributed as [i]"Clear Glasses"[/i]). Both hook the render pipeline deeply; with both installed the world renders as a solid orange/black on load until you open and close a menu. Please disable one. (Built-in high-quality upscaling is planned so this won't be needed.)[/color][/*]
[/list][color=#D4D4D8]
[size=5]❓ FAQ[/size][/color]
[list]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Is it safe to uninstall?[/b] Yes, it touches no save data. Remove the folder any time.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Does it phone home?[/b] No network calls, no telemetry.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Why does X look off with mod Y?[/b] Post a SMAPI log ([url=https://smapi.io/log]smapi.io/log[/url]) + a screenshot on the Bugs tab. See the pinned template.[/color][/*]
[/list][color=#D4D4D8]
[size=5]🐛 Reporting bugs[/size]
Please include: (1) a [url=https://smapi.io/log]SMAPI log link[/url], (2) a screenshot/clip, (3) your zoom level + resolution, (4) which effects are on, (5) the location/time/weather. Graphics bugs are visual: a picture beats three paragraphs.

[size=5]🙏 Credits[/size]
Built on SMAPI, MonoGame, and Generic Mod Config Menu. This mod reimplements its effects from scratch; see CREDITS in the download. Thanks to the Stardew modding community. There are excellent lighting mods out there, and this one simply takes a single-suite, read-what-renders approach.

[size=5]☕ Support[/size]
Free and always will be. If it brightened your farm, a coffee is appreciated but never required:[/color]
[list]
[*][color=#d4d4d8]Ko-fi: [/color][url=https://ko-fi.com/phuicmt]ko-fi.com/phuicmt[/url][/*]
[/list][color=#D4D4D8]
[size=5]🌏 Languages[/size]
Bundled: English, Thai, Simplified Chinese (by [url=https://forums.nexusmods.com/profile/194031764-rime961/]rime961[/url], included from 1.2.2). Italian in the works.
Also on the Nexus, and thank you both: a Korean translation by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/49448]jjongleee[/url] and a [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/49647]Chinese translation[/url] by Rubbish404, listed under Translations above.
Huge thanks to everyone translating this mod. A heads-up though: the mod is still evolving quickly, so text keys and settings names may change between updates, and your translation might need small updates later. I know that's extra work and I really appreciate your patience. I'll list text changes in each changelog to make catching up easier. ♥[/color]
